hero.h1: Directive 8020 Walkthrough Hub | Eight Chapters & Play Styles
hero.intro: Use this hub to plan a run and find chapter notes. The official Steam achievement list confirms eight episodes; the scene-by-scene notes linked below are still being checked.

blocks.text: Choose Explorer if you want to revisit decisions during the story. In Survivor, the first run commits you to the consequences and Turning Points unlock if you reach the ending. Review difficulty, QTE and accessibility settings separately.

These original chapter URLs currently show individual review notices. The former scene instructions, passwords, location claims and outcome predictions have been withdrawn, and the chapter pages are temporarily excluded from indexing. A page without a translation opens in English.

items: Record your platform, game version, play style and save before trying a route.
Note the actual choice text and the result you observed, rather than relying on an informal label.
Change one decision at a time when comparing branches; record later consequences as well.
Check a collectible or achievement requirement against its own platform source.

sections.heading: What this hub does not establish

blocks.text: The chapter count does not verify the old chapter subtitles, every recorded scene, a fixed completion time or a guaranteed best ending. Earlier first-person claims of three tested runs have been withdrawn; they are not evidence for any route.
